## Description (paste as plain text)

Invite everyone to your Thanksgiving table with an animated invitation they unwrap on their phone. A gift-wrapped card with a ribbon and bow opens with one tap, then autumn leaves fall across the screen. Edit it in minutes with no code and share one link by WhatsApp, text or email. Perfect if you need to send your invitations today.

✨ WHAT YOUR GUESTS SEE
• A gift-wrapped card with a ribbon, a bow and a "You're Invited" tag. One tap unties the bow and the card opens
• Falling autumn leaves and a hanging leaf garland
• "THANKSGIVING Dinner" in big capitals and elegant script
• A live countdown to the day
• Date, time and address, with one-tap Google Maps directions
• Add to calendar (Apple, Google, Outlook)
• Attire, with fall colour suggestions
• Schedule, menu, a "What to Bring" potluck list, "Good to Know" notes and a "Thank You" message (turn any section on or off)
• Built-in RSVP: guests choose yes or no, the number of guests, any allergies, and the dish they'll bring
• Optional music: a built-in music box, or your own MP3. It only plays when a guest taps the music button

🍂 3 THEMES INCLUDED
• Harvest Night: candlelit browns with burnt orange and amber
• Rustic Farmhouse: kraft paper, buffalo plaid and a wooden table
• Sage & Terracotta: soft sage green with a terracotta ribbon
Switch theme with one click, as often as you like.

🦃 FOR ANY GATHERING
The wording is written for you: Thanksgiving Dinner, Friendsgiving, Thanksgiving Potluck, Thanksgiving Brunch, Office Thanksgiving or Family Thanksgiving. You can also change every word yourself.

📩 RSVPS STRAIGHT TO YOUR PHONE
Choose how replies reach you:
• WhatsApp: the guest's reply opens as a ready-to-send message to your number
• Email: the reply opens as a ready-to-send email to you
• Your own form link (for example a Google Form)
No account, no app and no monthly fees.

🖥 SO EASY TO EDIT
Open the editor in your browser and fill in a simple form. The invitation updates live as you type. Add your own photo, change every word, and save your draft to come back later. No coding and nothing to install.

✅ HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files
2. Open the editor on a computer and fill in your details
3. Download your finished invitation
4. Publish it with Canva (step-by-step guide included) to get your link
5. Share your link by WhatsApp, text message or email

📦 WHAT YOU GET
• Easy editor (editor.html)
• Invitation template with all 3 themes (index.html)
• Step-by-step PDF guide

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Use a computer (laptop or desktop) to edit. Guests can open the invitation on any phone or computer.
• You need a Canva account to publish your invitation.
• RSVPs arrive by WhatsApp, email or your own form. There is no guest list dashboard.
• The pumpkins, candles and leaves are illustrations, not photos. You can add your own photo.
• For personal use. Please do not resell or share the files.
• I created this invitation and its editor with the help of AI tools.
• Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is unclear, send me a message and I'll gladly help.

Happy Thanksgiving! 🍂
